name: Group_Energy_Flight
display_fullname: Peacebringer Defensive Luminous Aura Group Energy Flight
display_help: Solar Glide moderately increases your flight speed and provides a high amount of defense, flight protection, and additional flight control. If however, you are not flying, you will lose some of your Defense bonus. Taking this power also unlocks Group Energy Flight, a power that endows your nearby teammates with Flight when active. This power only grants flight protection while Combat Flight or Energy Fly is active. While Solar Glide is active, Acrobatics and Weave will suppress.
